description: Swiss & High-Contrast / Modern Lab Instrument - Scientific, precise, premium, dense, hyper-legible, data-centric.
vibe: Scientific, precise, premium, dense, hyper-legible, data-centric.

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl font-black tracking-tighter leading-none text-zinc-50

layout_and_spacing.card_style: bg-[#0A0A0A] border border-zinc-800 p-4 md:p-6 shadow-none flex flex-col hover:border-zinc-700 transition-colors

components.buttons: Flat, sharp edges. Primary: bg-amber-500 text-black hover:bg-amber-400 font-bold. Secondary: border border-zinc-700 bg-transparent text-zinc-300 hover:text-white hover:border-zinc-600
components.tables: Extremely dense. py-2 text-sm font-mono for data cells. border-b border-zinc-800/50. Hover states on rows: bg-zinc-900/50.
components.inputs: bg-transparent border-zinc-800 text-zinc-100 focus:border-amber-500 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-amber-500 rounded-sm font-mono text-sm.

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid #262626. Use the 'Grid Borders' micro-theme: expose the skeleton of the layout.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Avoid entirely for dashboards. Use flat solid dark grays to prevent data refraction and maintain clinical precision.
visual_enhancers.textures: Add a very subtle 2% noise overlay to the main background to reduce digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.charts: No soft gradients. Use sharp, distinct color blocks (Amber, Crimson, Off-White) for Sunbursts and Donut charts.

chromosome_ideogram.styling: Dark mode SVG. Chromosome backbone in #262626, active segments mapped with Amber/Crimson, centromeres marked with white. Hover tooltips must snap precisely to bp locations.

haplogroup_globe.styling: arcs color: Amber/Crimson, background: transparent. Remove atmosphere glow for flat technical look. Globe map must be dark.

ancestry_sunburst.styling: Flat SVG paths. High contrast boundaries (1px black stroke between segments).

hero_image.description: Abstract high-end 3D visualization of DNA helix, used for login/onboarding background or empty states. Max overlay black/40.

chromosome_abstract.description: Microscopic view of chromosomes, useful for marketing landing page or header graphics.

iconography.style: duotone or regular. Precise, geometric. Avoid playful/rounded icons.

accessibility.contrast: WCAG AA minimum (4.5:1 for body text)
accessibility.data_testid_requirement: CRITICAL: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes in kebab-case

instructions_to_main_agent: Install and use '@phosphor-icons/react' as the icon library.
DO NOT default to purple or teal. Stick strictly to the Obsidian/Amber/Crimson palette defined.
Use raw HTML/Tailwind for the landing page. Use Shadcn + deep customization for the dashboard.
Use D3.js for the Chromosome Ideogram. It requires D3 for precise raw coordinate mapping (start/stop bp).
Use react-globe.gl for the Haplogroup migration map.
Implement the 'Control Room' dense grid for the dashboard. 1px borders, minimal radii, maximum data visibility.
Use IBM Plex Mono for all genomic coordinates (chr positions, cM, start/stop values).
